messages.text:
This unit didn't work out of the box as it would not save WiFi settings.
You had me put another operating system on it and now the unit has failed
weeks later.  The led thing over the unit just flashes red.  Overclocking
part of the order has never shipped.  Need refund / exchange - what are you
going to do?

Nathan
Handed to the team · refund and replacement approval both need a person; agent cannot refund or autho

Hi Nathan,

Sorry, that unit has let you down twice now. One thing to clear up first: the firmware change was done at our direction, so it has no effect on your cover. The B.2 is in warranty.

Here is what happens. Start the return here so the prepaid label goes out to you: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform . Put Shop···· on it and describe both the Wi-Fi fault at the start and the red flashing failure now. Alongside that, I have asked Abel and Georges to approve a straight replacement or the $360 back rather than a repair, given it never ran properly from day one.

On the Overclocking line, $59.99, it has not shipped and its date has gone by. The September 16 notice offered a full refund of that line on request, so I have put that through to the team to refund to your original payment method.

A colleague is picking both of those up today and will confirm the amounts in this thread, so there is nothing more for you to send.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Sarah,

I received the RMA label to ship the unit back and it was shipped this past
Monday.

I have not received a refund for the Overclocking and just today received
an email that it has shipped - why wasn't I credited and refunded?

Nathan
Handed to the team · refund crossed with a shipment; only a person can issue the money

Hi Nathan,

You're right to ask, and the honest answer is that the two crossed. Stock for the Overclocking kit landed at our Chattanooga warehouse and it was picked and shipped on October 14, tracking ····, due with you around October 21. That went out before the refund was processed, so the money is still on the order rather than back with you.

That does not have to stand. You asked for the $59.99 back and I've put it straight to Abel and Georges today, with the note that the kit is in transit. When it arrives you can simply refuse it at the door, or hold it and they'll send a label. Either way you are not paying for something you asked us to cancel. They'll confirm the amount in this thread.

On the BS-2, thanks for getting it out Monday. Nothing has checked in at the returns warehouse yet, which is normal for a few days in transit. Once it lands, inspection runs up to 10 days, and the team will come back here on the replacement or the $360.

Sorry you had to chase this one.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support

Hi Sarah,

The O. unit arrived today.  Can a label be provided to send it
back for a refund?

Thank you
Nathan

Hi Nathan,

No need to send it back, and nothing more for you to do. The $59.99 for the Overclocking kit was already refunded to your original card on October 16, and Georges asked that you keep the kit with our compliments for the trouble this one caused.

The rest is settled too. Your BS-2 reached the Chattanooga warehouse and the remaining $414.49 went back to your Visa on October 21, so the whole of Shop····, $474.48, has now been refunded. Depending on your bank it can take a few business days to appear on the statement.

So the order is closed out in full and the kit is yours. If anything about it does not land on your card in the next few days, just reply here and I'll chase it.

Thanks for your patience through all of this, Nathan.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy support
